Adapted in AvionicsUi/Fui/AvStepProgress.cs: bounded current/max step state,
normalized progress and percentage fill width. Ported from VisualElement to the existing
uGUI canvas; vertex colour shading replaces per-update generated gradient textures.
This is a source adaptation, not a runtime migration to UI Toolkit or a complete package installation.
